title: Simulations
description: Simulations includes conformance event results organized by simulated event number and model type: RAS, HMS, ResSim, and system response. Hydraulic results are organized by model unit. model-unit.p01.hdf includes event conditions, geometry, plan data, and results; model-unit.p01.tmp.hdf provides input data required for cloud simulation. ras-event-summary.json summarizes 2D-area cumulative net precipitation and volume accounting error, boundary condition lines, breaching status, reference-line peak flows, water surface elevations (WSEL), velocities, structure variable peaks, computation time, core count, run time window, solution status, and instability information. rasoutput.log records the RAS version, progress, iteration status, volume accounting and water surface elevation errors, and other warnings or errors. Hydrologic outputs include SST.dss time-series and paired HMS data, exported-precip.dss gridded precipitation, and exported-precip.tmp.hdf gridded precipitation required for cloud compute. exported-precip.dss is optional, generated by request to the Cloud Compute Lead, and required to reproduce a cloud-simulated event on desktop. Reservoir-operations outputs include 1h_peaks.csv, 24h_peaks.csv, 48h_peaks.csv, and 72h_peaks.csv summarizing ResSim element peaks, ffrd.simperiod matching the ResSim time window to HMS for seasonal pool operations, and simulation.dss time-series and paired ResSim output. System-response failure_elevations.json records sampled failure or breach elevations, with location identifiers such as NID or NLD and the failure_elevation triggering a breach. Event validation provides final historic-event replication results through the full model suite prepared for cloud compute as QC of the linked models. Logs record HMS simulation times and failures. The simulation storm catalog indexes storm event numbers, DSS paths, fishnet x and y coordinates, seasonality-dependent sampled start time, antecedent condition, and calibration event parameters as SST output. Summary data are divided by model type. Hydraulic summaries include model-unit maximum and minimum flows and WSEL for boundary-condition lines, reference lines, and reference points, computation time, simulation status, instability time, cumulative net precipitation, and volume accounting error. HMS and ResSim summaries cover 1-, 24-, 48-, and 72-hour output periods. Interactive plots show flow and stage frequency, stage-discharge rating curves, volume accounting error versus precipitation, and precipitation frequency, with zooming and querying by event plotting position and observed or published comparisons where available. Breach plots summarize individual dams and levees and all structures across simulated events. blocks_fixed_length.json relates events to synthetic years or blocks and blocks to realizations. Combined_AMS_Contributing_10yr.csv lists annual-maximum-series contributing events, also the events to compute in HEC-RAS; Combined_AMS_Contributing_Explain_10yr.csv gives the rationale for each contributing event.
